Info

Defines FaultEvent domain model representing firmware critical fault notification.

class scarajectory.core.model.telemetry.fault_event.FaultEvent(*, severity: int, fault_code: int, extra_info: int)[source]¶

Bases: object

Domain model representing asynchronous hardware fault events dispatched by firmware.

It defines:

attributes:
severity - Fault severity level (0=WARN, 1=RECOVERABLE, 2=CRITICAL).
fault_code - Hardware error/fault identifier code.
extra_info - Additional auxiliary diagnostic bitmask or error context.
extra_info: int¶
fault_code: int¶
severity: int¶
